excerpt.zh:
随着我们继续在这个星球上净化那些肮脏的异星渣滓，我们的[GetCollectionRewardCategory]战利品收集愈发充盈。

希望这些展品能成为这个污秽星系的残骸，进一步激励我们履行誓言。
excerpt.en:
As we continue our efforts to cleanse this world of filthy xeno scum, our collection of [GetCollectionRewardCategory] trophies has grown.

May these exhibits serve as the carcass of this contaminated galaxy and further inspire us in our sworn mission.

texts.zh:
饥饿并未消退。在我们吞噬的征途中，[GetCollectionRewardCategory]奇物的收藏不断增长。

愿这些展品成为我们吞噬的星系的最后记忆。
texts.en:
The hunger does not wane. Our collection of [GetCollectionRewardCategory] curios has grown during our campaign of consumption.

May these exhibits serve as the last memories of the galaxy we have devoured.

May these exhibits serve as the last memories of the galaxy we have devoured.

texts.zh:
我们收集了一批[GetCollectionRewardCategory]物品，这些物品被有机生命体认为是独特的文物，具有价值。

在我们的监控下，这些物品将在有机生命体从这个星系中灭绝很久之后依然存在。
texts.en:
We have gathered a selection of [GetCollectionRewardCategory] items that the organics believed to hold value as unique artifacts.

Under our surveillance, these items will endure long after organic life has been exterminated from this galaxy.

texts.zh:
我们继续从这个肮脏的恒星系中收集[GetCollectionRewardCategory]物品，奇珍异宝和古怪的东西。

让我们花点时间欣赏我们的战利品，但要知道，外面还有更多东西等着我们去获取。
texts.en:
We continue to amass [GetCollectionRewardCategory] objects, baubles and oddities from this filthy galaxy.

Let us take a moment to admire our trophies, but know that there is so much more out there to take.

texts.zh:
我们继续收集[GetCollectionRewardCategory]饰品，这些饰品是低等生命形式播下的污染的残余。

一旦所有令人作呕的异形都被从星空中清除，这些物品将提醒我们它们低等的本质。
texts.en:
We continue to amass [GetCollectionRewardCategory] trinkets, remnants of the contamination that has been sown by inferior lifeforms.

Once every disgusting xeno has been purged from the stars, these items will remind us of their inferior nature.

texts.zh:
我们继续收集[GetCollectionRewardCategory]样本，这些是这个星系的古老血肉。

当我们享用美食时，这些物品将提醒我们回忆那些已经消耗了无数次的盛宴。
texts.en:
We continue to amass [GetCollectionRewardCategory] specimens, ancient pieces of the flesh of this galaxy.

As we feast, these items will serve to remind us of the countless fodder we have consumed.

texts.zh:
我们继续收集[GetCollectionRewardCategory]的小饰品，这些奇特的古玩曾经被低等生命体珍视。

当我们享用美食时，这些物品将提醒我们回忆那些已经消耗了无数次的盛宴。
texts.en:
We continue to amass [GetCollectionRewardCategory] trinkets, peculiar curios that were once held in regard by inferior lifeforms.

As we feast, these items will serve to remind us of the countless fodder we have consumed.

texts.zh:
我们一边收集[GetCollectionRewardCategory]战利品，一边消除这个星系中所有有机生命的污点。

这些物品将提醒我们在未来灭绝协议的过程中，我们见证了有机生命的非理性。
texts.en:
We continue to amass [GetCollectionRewardCategory] trophies as we remove the stain of organic life from this galaxy.

These items will serve to remind us of illogicity of organic life in the service of future extermination protocols.

texts.zh:
我们已经用[GetCollectionRewardCategory]的物品填满了我们的仓库，这些是这个星系的古老血肉。

我们认为这庞大的收藏是记录我们毁灭一切的证明。让所有人都见证我们的胜利。
texts.en:
We have filled our stores with [GetCollectionRewardCategory] objects, the ancient flesh of this galaxy.

We consider this vast collection to be a record of our destruction of it all. Let all gaze upon our triumphs.

texts.zh:
我们已经用[GetCollectionRewardCategory]奇物填满了我们的仓库，这些奇物是毫无意义的外星装饰品的宝库。

我们看着这庞大的收藏，嘲笑我们那些可怜的低等生物。想想吧，一旦他们被消灭，这些展示柜将是他们留下的唯一遗迹。
texts.en:
We have filled our stores with [GetCollectionRewardCategory] curios, a veritable wealth of meaningless xeno ornaments.

We look upon this vast collection and laugh at the pitiful nature of our inferiors. To think, once they have been exterminated, these display cases will be all that remain of them.

texts.zh:
我们在这片星系中尽情享用，已经将仓库填满了[GetCollectionRewardCategory]奇珍异宝。

这庞大的收藏只提醒着我们那无法满足的饥渴。当这片星系被完全吞噬后，我们将看着这些物品，回味着品尝的记忆。
texts.en:
As we feasted so thoroughly on this galaxy, we have filled our stores with [GetCollectionRewardCategory] curios.

This vast collection serves only to remind us of the hunger that cannot be sated. Once this galaxy has been devoured in full, we will look upon these items and savor the memories of taste.

texts.zh:
随着对星系的净化，我们用于储存[GetCollectionRewardCategory]物种的记忆空间已经填满。

这些收藏提供了关于有机物倾向于珍视什么的数据。这将有助于我们进一步消灭它们，并作为这个受感染星系的历史参考点而存在。
texts.en:
As we have purged this galaxy, we have filled our memory banks assigned to [GetCollectionRewardCategory] specimens.

This collection provides data on what organics tend to hold dear. It will serve to further their eradication and exist as reference points in the history of this infected galaxy.
